Booking Experience

Request an appointment.

This deployed demo stores appointment requests in Amazon DynamoDB through API Gateway and Lambda. Requests remain pending until Blooming Lotus confirms them.

Demo data flow: bloominglotus.denduluru.com → API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB. No payment or medical information is collected in this demo.

Appointment Request

Demo workflow — your request is saved to the demo database, but it is not a confirmed appointment until Blooming Lotus contacts you.

Therapist Options

Built around the team.

  • Jack — selectable therapist
  • Rose — selectable therapist
  • Mike — selectable therapist & manager
  • No preference — any available therapist

AWS Demo Backend

Requests are stored in DynamoDB.

  • Browser → API Gateway HTTP API
  • API Gateway → AWS Lambda
  • Lambda validates the request
  • DynamoDB stores it as REQUESTED
